brief:
Israeli forces carried out raids in the occupied West Bank areas of Salfit and Nablus on Saturday, detaining at least one Palestinian man, the Wafa news agency reported. The operations targeted several parts of both districts during the day.

No additional details were provided about the identity of the detainee, the reasons for the raids, or the specific locations targeted within the two governorates.
dek: Israeli forces raid West Bank areas of Salfit and Nablus, detain Palestinian man Israeli forces have carried out raids in several parts of the occupied West Bank and detained at least one person on Saturday, Wafa reported.
title: Israeli forces raid West Bank, detain Palestinian man
